categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou Xili Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of electric energy metering products including smart meters (single-phase and three-phase), electricity information collection terminals, and energy metering boxes. The company also develops related products such as smart water meters, smart gateways, smart sockets, and mobile power supplies, expanding into public energy metering and power distribution markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies in high-precision metering, software modular design, database management, control circuit design, communication, data security, and automated production. It has developed proprietary technologies such as high-reliability data storage middleware, adaptive power management, high-precision metering compensation algorithms, and automated production quality control systems (MES). The production is order-based with integrated ERP and MES systems ensuring traceability and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major power grid companies including State Grid Corporation of China and China Southern Power Grid, along with their provincial subsidiaries and local power companies. The products serve electricity utilities for metering and data collection in residential, industrial, and commercial sectors. The company also exports to Southeast Asia and Africa, targeting emerging smart grid markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province. It has a nationwide sales and technical service network covering all provinces. Overseas markets include Southeast Asia and Africa, with exports growing but still a smaller portion of revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xili Technology operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the electric energy metering supply chain, focusing on product design, manufacturing, and sales of smart meters and related data collection devices. It also produces some upstream components like transformers and meter shells to ensure supply stability and cost control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in smart metering technologies aligned with national smart grid and energy internet initiatives. R&D priorities include developing next-generation smart meters compliant with new standards, dual-mode communication units, and intelligent energy management systems. It invests heavily in modular design, automation, and expanding into new energy and public energy metering products. Collaboration with universities and research institutes supports advanced technology development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of smart meters, electricity information collection terminals, and energy metering boxes to power grid companies via competitive bidding and contracts. The company also earns income from exports and related services. There is no indication of subscription or licensing revenue models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a nationally recognized high-tech enterprise with a strong market position in China's smart meter industry. It holds a comprehensive product portfolio and advanced technology, consistently rated as a top-tier supplier (A-class) by State Grid. Competitors include other domestic smart meter manufacturers, but Xili's integrated R&D, production automation, and quality management provide competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 587 million, a 3.88% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 103.7 million, up 39.31%. The company maintains a solid financial scale with total assets around RMB 1 billion and equity exceeding RMB 830 million. It shows steady growth driven by increased sales of high-margin products and expanded market share.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xili Technology emphasizes high-precision, low-power, multifunctional smart metering products with advanced communication and data security features. Its value proposition includes rapid technical response, mature automated production systems, and comprehensive quality management ensuring product reliability and compliance with evolving industry standards. The company also offers customized solutions and maintains strong R&D capabilities to meet diverse customer needs.
